title: Childcare Workers
description: Attend to children at schools, businesses, private households, and childcare institutions. Perform a variety of tasks, such as dressing, feeding, bathing, and overseeing play.

tasks.text: Maintain a safe play environment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Ensuring child physical safety requires presence

dwas.name: Arrange childcare or educational settings to ensure physical safety of children.

tasks.text: Observe and monitor children's play activities.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Live monitoring of people in physical settings

dwas.name: Monitor activities of individuals to ensure safety or compliance with rules.

tasks.text: Communicate with children's parents or guardians about daily activities, behaviors, and related issues.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Child development discussion needs live human presence

dwas.name: Discuss child development and behavior with parents or guardians.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Support children's emotional and social development, encouraging understanding of others and positive self-concepts.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Comfort and encouragement need live emotional presence

dwas.name: Provide counsel, comfort, or encouragement to individuals or families.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Care for children in institutional setting, such as group homes, nursery schools, private businesses, or schools for people with disabilities.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on support for special-needs individuals

dwas.name: Assist individuals with special needs.

tasks.text: Sanitize toys and play equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Tool cleaning is physical manipulation

dwas.name: Clean tools or equipment.

tasks.text: Dress children and change diapers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical care of children in real world

dwas.name: Provide for basic needs of children.

tasks.text: Keep records on individual children, including daily observations and information about activities, meals served, and medications administered.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Maintain client records; human owns sensitive judgment

dwas.name: Maintain client information or service records.

tasks.text: Identify signs of emotional or developmental problems in children and bring them to parents' or guardians' attention.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Child development discussion needs live human presence

dwas.name: Monitor health or behavior of people or animals.
Discuss child development and behavior with parents or guardians.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Instruct children in health and personal habits, such as eating, resting, and toilet habits.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Hygiene teaching is interpersonal and situational

dwas.name: Teach health or hygiene practices.

tasks.text: Organize and store toys and materials to ensure order in activity areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Arranging items is physical placement

dwas.name: Arrange items for use or display.

tasks.text: Perform general administrative tasks, such as taking attendance, editing internal paperwork, and making phone calls.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Broad clerical tasks partly automatable, human oversees exceptions

dwas.name: Perform administrative or clerical tasks.

tasks.text: Create developmentally appropriate lesson plans.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Drafts training programs; needs analysis and delivery human

dwas.name: Develop educational or training programs.

tasks.text: Perform housekeeping duties, such as laundry, cleaning, dish washing, and changing of linens.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Housekeeping is physical labor in varied spaces

dwas.name: Perform housekeeping duties.

tasks.text: Read to children and teach them simple painting, drawing, handicrafts, and songs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Daily living skills taught in person with feedback

dwas.name: Teach daily living skills or behaviors.

tasks.text: Assist in preparing food and serving meals and refreshments to children.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on meal preparation

dwas.name: Prepare foods or meals.

tasks.text: Discipline children and recommend or initiate other measures to control behavior, such as caring for own clothing and picking up toys and books.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Daily living skills taught in person with feedback

dwas.name: Teach daily living skills or behaviors.

tasks.text: Regulate children's rest periods.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Drafting schedules; family context needs human tailoring

dwas.name: Develop daily schedules for children or families.

tasks.text: Organize and participate in recreational activities and outings, such as games and field trips.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Event organizing aided; logistics and presence human

dwas.name: Organize recreational activities or events.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Sterilize bottles and prepare formulas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Tool cleaning is physical manipulation

dwas.name: Clean tools or equipment.

tasks.text: Help children with homework and school work.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Daily living skills taught in person with feedback

dwas.name: Teach daily living skills or behaviors.

tasks.text: Provide care for children with physical, developmental, or mental health disabilities.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Therapeutic mental health care is relational

dwas.name: Care for patients with mental illnesses.

tasks.text: Perform general personnel functions, such as supervision, training, and scheduling.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Assignments drafted; accountability and negotiation human

dwas.name: Assign duties or work schedules to employees.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

dwas.name: Train service staff.
Perform human resources activities.

tasks.text: Accompany children to and from school, on outings, and to medical appointments.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physically accompanying groups in real environments

dwas.name: Accompany individuals or groups to activities.
